name: XlUpdateLinks
description: Specifies a workbook's setting for updating embedded OLE links.

constants.name: xlUpdateLinksUserSetting
constants.description: Embedded OLE links are updated according to the user's settings for the specified workbook.

constants.name: xlUpdateLinksNever
constants.description: Embedded OLE links are never updated for the specified workbook.

constants.name: xlUpdateLinksAlways
constants.description: Embedded OLE links are always updated for the specified workbook.
